summary: Rodney Vanderpool, 55, was accused of shooting at Syracuse police officers on May 9, 2026, injuring three. He had been released without bail in March on sex abuse charges dating to 2013.

prior_offenses: attempted murder of two police officers; shooting at officers during pursuit
prior_evidence_quote: Rodriguez was serving time for charges in a 2017 shootout with Stockton police. Authorities said he shot at officers during a pursuit, with some of the bullets piercing their police cruiser.
release_evidence_quote: In November 2025, less than halfway through his prison sentence, Rodriguez was allowed to go free.
summary: Steven Rodriguez, 57, a California man who was released early under the state's compassionate release law in November 2025 after serving time for attempted murder of two Stockton police officers, was arrested on May 7, 2026, after authorities found a loaded short-barrel shotgun in his car during a traffic stop and he now faces multiple weapons-related charges and parole violations.
